definitions.explanation: Not yet completed. Used for works of art, literature, projects, or tasks that remain unfinished.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未完|みかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
{未完|みかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An unfinished work is on display.

examples.japanese: ⟦{作者|さくしゃ}→作者：04169_sakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大作|たいさく}→大作：12196_taisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未完|みかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Because the author passed away, this great work was left unfinished.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {未完|みかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (unfinished work). Also appears as a predicate or label: {未完|みかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end incomplete). Common in literary and artistic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未完|みかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (unfinished work)
- {未完|みかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to remain unfinished)
- ⟦{未完成|みかんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧ (incomplete — a related but distinct word meaning not yet perfected)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未完成|みかんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧: incomplete, not yet finished — implies something still in progress that could be completed
- {未完|みかん}: unfinished — often implies the work will never be completed
